newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone firm on report of Energis deal.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone firm on report of Energis deal.

text.p: Shares in mobile phone operator Vodafone Plc firmed in active trade early on Monday as a report in the Financial Times said the company was set to move into fixed telecom services.
Quoting Vodafone's chief executive Chris Gent, the FT said Vodafone was close to an agreement with National Grid Group Plc to sell services of the latter's phone network Energis.
Vodafone shares were up 1-1/2p at 297 by 0754 GMT in volume of 1.4 million shares, making it London's second most active stock at that stage. NGG was up 7-1/2p at 266-1/2.
The FT said the deal would allow Vodafone to offer a full range of services under its own brand name and that customers would receive a single bill covering fixed and mobile phones.
The paper said Energis hoped the Vodafone deal would bring more volume onto its network.
No-one at Vodafone or Energis was immediately available for comment.
